title: Ingest data seamlessly
content: ClickHouse is designed to handle huge volumes of continuous streams of ingest data, supporting ingestion rates of gigabytes per second. Seamlessly connect your external data sources to ClickHouse Cloud with [ClickPipes](/cloud/clickpipes).

title: Leverage resources efficiency
content: ClickHouse is purpose-built to deliver the most efficient utilization of resources, which results in significant cost savings. Unlike other JVM-based solutions, ClickHouse can exploit the full resources of a machine and scale both horizontally and vertically to systems with hundreds of cores and petabytes of storage.

title: Manage data flexibly
content: ClickHouse’s column-oriented design delivers best-in-class compression ratios, reducing storage burden and further accelerating query performance. [Flexible storage policies](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/integrations/s3) and [MergeTree table engines](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/engines/table-engines/mergetree-family/mergetree#table_engine-mergetree-multiple-volumes) allow data to reside on local disks for defined periods before migrating to object storage, creating “hot” and “cold” tiers to balance query performance and storage efficiency.

title: Unlock your real-time analytics
content: ClickHouse is designed from the ground up to power the most intensive real-time workloads. Combine our extensive suite of aggregation and analytical functions with optimizations to further accelerate queries and ensure blazingly-fast data analysis for critical workloads.
